about-us.title: About Us
about-us.html:
Phantom Dynamics has been in business for over 20 years, supplying products and services for nightclubs, DJs, bars, bands, and special effects projects with many high-end companies. We are committed to excellent customer service and offer a wide selection of high-end lighting and audio systems.

All products sold are brand new and covered by factory warranties. We personally review each manufacturer and vendor to ensure we provide only the highest quality products and systems.

Phantom Dynamics is hosted by BigCommerce and provides a secure shopping experience using SSL (Secure Socket Layer) encryption technology.

Nightclub Design Services

Designing nightclubs, theaters, or performance venues to impress your audience can be a challenge. Over the years, Phantom Dynamics has assisted clients by providing quick, affordable consulting, planning, and design solutions.

From LED and laser lighting systems to full theatrical stage packages, our team specializes in creating the right atmosphere and theme for your venue.

Clients include major names like Disney, Apple, Golfsmith, NASA, and the U.S. Military. No project is too large or small for our experienced lighting team.

We offer consulting and design services on a case-by-case basis and are available for on-site evaluations and installations nationwide.

For more information, contact us at sales@phantomdynamics.com.

shipping-returns.title: Shipping & Returns
shipping-returns.html:
Phantom Dynamics Store Policies

New Items & Warranty

All products are brand new, factory sealed, and backed by the manufacturer's warranty.

Free Shipping Offer

  • Free shipping on most U.S. orders over $299.99.* some restrictions apply
  • Ships via FedEx, UPS, or USPS Ground.
  • Free shipping excludes Alaska, Hawaii, U.S. Territories
  • Eligible items will show a free shipping option at checkout.
  • Oversized items, fluids, speakers, subwoofers, and some laser projectors or heavy orders may require truck freight and incur additional charges

Order Processing

Orders are processed within 24–48 hours. Address and billing verification may cause delays.

Product Info & Specifications

Descriptions, specs, and images may change without notice due to manufacturer updates. Phantom Dynamics is not responsible for such changes.

Shipping Notes

  • Special orders, international shipments, rush orders, or bulk orders may incur additional fees.
  • Insurance may be added for high-value items.
  • Some items may ship directly from the manufacturer.

Order Acceptance & Returns

  • Inspect shipments immediately upon arrival.
  • Report any damage, missing, or incorrect items within 10 days.
  • Refuse damaged packages and notify us for a replacement.
  • Failure to report within 10 days may result in the buyer covering return shipping costs.

Delays

Phantom Dynamics is not responsible for delays caused by shipping carriers, supply chain issues, weather, or other uncontrollable events. Please plan accordingly.

Return Policy

  • Returns require a Return Material Authorization (RMA) number.
  • Eligible products must be unopened, unused, and in resaleable condition.
  • No returns on any fluids, bulbs, software, custom items, special orders, bulk orders, laser projectors, mirror balls, or truck-freight items and or any items deemed not refundalbe from Phantom Dynamics
  • Used or damaged items may incur a 30%+ restocking fee or be denied credit or refund.
  • No returns accepted after 30 days. Unfinalized orders abandoned for 30+ days are void.

Shipping Fees

Shipping and handling fees are non-refundable. Returned items must be properly packaged and insured. Phantom Dynamics is not liable for damage during return shipping.

Out-of-Stock Items

If an item is out of stock, we will notify you via email or phone with options or estimated shipping dates.

Laser Projectors

All laser projectors over 5mW require an FDA variance. The customer is responsible for securing this documentation.

International Orders

  • All payments must be made in U.S. dollars via wire transfer. Credit cards are not accepted for international orders.
  • Shipping costs are calculated based on weight and destination, plus insurance.
  • Customer is responsible for any customs duties, taxes, or import fees.
  • Refused or undeliverable packages due to address issues or customs rejections are non-refundable.
  • Phantom Dynamics will not mark packages as gifts or undervalue items for customs.

Power Compatibility

All products are U.S. models. It is the buyer’s responsibility to ensure voltage compatibility in their country.

Fraud & Security

Suspicious or fraudulent orders will be reported to the FBI's Internet Fraud Complaint Center (IFCC).

Legal

  • Phantom Dynamics reserves the right to cancel any suspicious or questionable orders.
  • We are not responsible for typographical errors or supplier price changes.
  • All trademarks and logos are property of their respective owners and used for reference only.

Thank you for shopping at Phantom Dynamics!

privacy-policy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy-policy.html:
Phantom Dynamics collects customer information through it's website for the purpose of processing orders only. We do not share or sell any information you provide us online with any other company, affiliation or third party. We maintain a record of your purchases for reference only, and we collect your email address so we may communicate with you about your order. When you place an order with us, we process your order thru Authorize.Net and ZEN Payments merchant services.

All customer data is protected against unauthorized access. - Phantom Dynamics provides a secure shopping site with SSL (Secure Socket Layer) encryption technology for safe, secure and easy shopping.

All products are brand new, in unopened boxes and coverd under the manufactures limited warranty (if applicable)
